generation.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: original tool-recognition illustration for a Japanese agricultural training app. Create a square clean colored 2D product illustration showing exactly two separate complete manual screwdrivers: one Phillips/crosshead screwdriver with a clearly visible four-fluted cross-shaped steel working tip, and one slotted screwdriver with a clearly visible straight flattened flat-blade steel working tip. Both entire handles, shafts and tips must remain intact and visible. Arrange the screwdrivers apart in a three-quarter close perspective, handles farther away and tips toward the viewer, so both different working tips are large and plainly distinguishable without an inset. Use accurate ordinary tool anatomy, smooth steel gray shafts, one muted blue handle and one muted orange handle. Warm off-white plain background, restrained soft shading, crisp contours, generous clean margins, approachable high quality educational 2D illustration. No text, Japanese lettering, logos, watermark, numbers, labels, screw heads, hands, people, operation, cross-section, technical diagram, measurement markings, callout or inset. Do not reproduce any existing reference photo; invent an independent arrangement. Do not crop any tool.

captionJa: プラスとマイナスのドライバの例
altJa: 青い柄のプラスドライバと、橙色の柄のマイナスドライバ。金属の軸と異なる先端を大きく示した例。
limitsJa: 工具の形を学ぶための原図です。資料の小さな写真から先端を断定した復元図ではありません。色は識別基準ではなく、全製品の形状・規格・適合ねじ・締付け力・安全な整備手順を示しません。

authorVisualReview.observationsJa: 二本とも全体が画面内にあり、左は十字型へ向かう溝・稜のある先端、右は平らな刃状の先端を大きく示します。先端の見え方は独立したAIレビューで再確認が必要です。
